mapper.sql:
WHERE q.deleted = 0 AND q.status = 1 AND c.status = 1
AND q.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
AND q.difficulty = #{query.difficulty}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_tag qt WHERE qt.question_id = q.id AND qt.tag_id = #{query.tagId})
AND (q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\'
OR q.content_md LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR q.answer_md LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\'
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_tag qt2 JOIN tag t ON t.id = qt2.tag_id WHERE qt2.question_id = q.id AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\'))

(CASE WHEN q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_tag qt3 JOIN tag t3 ON t3.id = qt3.tag_id WHERE qt3.question_id = q.id AND t3.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\') THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN q.content_md LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN q.answer_md LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

CONCAT_WS(',', CASE WHEN q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' THEN 'title' END, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_tag qt4 JOIN tag t4 ON t4.id = qt4.tag_id WHERE qt4.question_id = q.id AND t4.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\') THEN 'tag' END, CASE WHEN (q.content_md LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR q.answer_md LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\') THEN 'body' END)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.category_id, c.name AS category_name, q.difficulty, q.view_count, q.practice_count, q.published_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_favorite f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.question_id = q.id) AS favorite,
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_view v WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.question_id = q.id) AS visited
NULL AS visited
, AS relevance , AS matchFields
FROM question q JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id
ORDER BY relevance DESC,
q.practice_count DESC, q.id DESC q.difficulty ASC, q.id ASC q.published_at DESC, q.id DESC
ORDER BY q.practice_count DESC, q.id DESC
ORDER BY q.difficulty ASC, q.id ASC
ORDER BY q.published_at DESC, q.id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.content_md, q.answer_md, q.difficulty, q.category_id, c.name AS category_name, q.view_count, q.practice_count, q.published_at FROM question q JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id WHERE q.id = #{id} AND q.deleted = 0 AND q.status = 1
SELECT id FROM question WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND id < #{id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM question WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND id > #{id} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH ordered AS ( SELECT f.question_id AS id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC) AS rn FROM user_favorite f JOIN question q ON q.id = f.question_id AND q.deleted = 0 AND q.status = 1 JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id AND c.status = 1 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ) SELECT (SELECT id FROM ordered WHERE rn = (SELECT rn FROM ordered WHERE id = #{id}) - 1) AS prev_id, (SELECT id FROM ordered WHERE rn = (SELECT rn FROM ordered WHERE id = #{id}) + 1) AS next_id
SELECT 1 FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT self_assess FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_view (user_id, question_id, first_viewed_at, last_viewed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_viewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
